extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome Web Store and browser UI

extDescription.message: Cap your screen time. Keep your day. Track time on every website and block them once your hourly, daily, or weekly limit is reached.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in Chrome Web Store

tour_confirmInterrupt.message: Are you sure you want to interrupt the guided tour?

tour_popup_intro_body.message: Open this from your browser toolbar any time. It shows today's browsing at a glance and your enabled rules.

tour_popup_manage_body.message: Click Manage rules to open the rules page and continue the tour.

tour_dash_welcome_body.message: A quick walk through every surface of $1, about two minutes. Use the × in the corner to leave anytime.

tour_dash_range_body.message: Choose a time range here. All charts and the table update to match.

tour_dash_topSites_body.message: Your five most-active sites for the selected range.

tour_dash_hourly_body.message: Your typical browsing pattern across the 24 hours of the day, averaged over the range.

tour_dash_table_body.message: Every site you visited in this range, with active time, audio playback and visit counts.

tour_dash_drill_body.message: Click any row in the table to drill into a site and see per-day detail.

tour_dash_timeline_body.message: Click View timeline to see exactly when you were on each site, plotted across the day, week or month.

tour_dash_popup_body.message: Click the $1 icon in your browser toolbar — or press Alt+Shift+C.

tour_dash_storage_body.message: Open Manage storage to view and manage stored data, delete data by range, or manage the cache.

tour_dash_settings_body.message: Open Settings to set the language, idle threshold, clock format and more.

tour_dash_complete_body.message: That's every feature of $1. Click here any time to replay the tour.

tour_rules_yourRules_body.message: This page shows your existing rules and general stats about how often they block.

tour_rules_addRule_body.message: Use this form to set a time limit for any site. Choose the scope, set a limit, and click Add rule.

tour_rules_back_body.message: Click the $1 logo to return to the dashboard and continue the tour.

tour_settings_main_body.message: Adjust the app's behavior settings here. Changes take effect immediately.

tour_settings_back_body.message: Click the $1 logo to return to the dashboard and finish the tour.

tour_site_details_body.message: This page shows everything $1 tracks for a single site. The site name and ID are shown here.

tour_site_charts_body.message: Four views of this site: active and audio time per day, an overview of totals and peaks, daily visit counts, and your typical pattern across the 24 clock hours.

tour_site_drillDay_body.message: Click any day in the time chart to see hourly detail for that single day.

tour_site_dailyDetail_body.message: The chosen day in finer detail. Move to neighboring days with the arrows, or switch between Time, Visits and Hourly average.

tour_site_backOverview_body.message: Click Overview to leave drill mode and return to the full range.

tour_site_pageActivity_body.message: Every subpage under this site. Click a row to drill into a subpage.

tour_path_details_body.message: The same view as the site page, for a single subpage: the charts, day drill-down and stats all work the same way.

tour_path_back_body.message: Go back to the site, then back to the dashboard, where the tour continues.

tour_tl_plotted_body.message: Each row is a site; the bars show active, audio and idle time laid along a real clock.

tour_tl_move_body.message: Step between periods with the arrows. Press up or down to switch between day, week and month; Escape jumps back to today.

tour_tl_back_body.message: Click the $1 logo to return to the dashboard; the tour continues there.

tour_storage_overview_body.message: At a glance: how many domains, subpages and rows you have, the active/audio/idle mix of your browsing data, your 10 MB quota headroom, and when you last exported.

tour_storage_tools_body.message: Tools to manage your data: remove insignificant rows, delete by site or date range, drop subpage detail, and clear the favicon cache.

tour_storage_back_body.message: Click the $1 logo to return to the dashboard; the tour continues there.

bg_notifyApproachingMessage.description: $1 = site label, $2 = percent, $3 = limit number, $4 = unit (hours/days), $5 = period adjective (hourly/daily/weekly), $6 = time remaining

popup_noRules.message: No active rules. Click Manage rules to add one.

hourly_noPastData.message: No data for past days yet.

rules_noRulesYet.message: No rules yet. Add one above to get started.

rules_reauth_one.message: $1 rule needs site access re-confirmed for blocking to work.

rules_reauth_other.message: $1 rules need site access re-confirmed for blocking to work.

rules_preview_invalidHost.message: "$1" doesn't look like a valid site (e.g. reddit.com).

rules_preview_addPath.message: Add a /path to limit a specific page.

rules_preview_covering.message: An existing $1 rule ($2) already covers this.
rules_preview_covering.description: $1 = period label, $2 = HTML link to the covering rule

rules_redundant_one.message: The rule you just added is stricter than $1 existing rule and would always block first. Disable it?

rules_redundant_other.message: The rule you just added is stricter than $1 existing rules and would always block first. Disable them?

rules_regex_alwaysBlock.message: Will always block URLs matching this pattern.

rules_regex_willBlock.message: Will block URLs matching this pattern.

settings_languageDesc.message: Language used across all pages. Automatic follows your browser's language.

settings_idleThresholdDesc.message: Time without keyboard or mouse input before $1 stops crediting active time on the focused tab.

settings_hourFormatDesc.message: Clock hour format used in charts (e.g. 14:00 vs 2 PM).

settings_weekStartConfirm.message: Changing the week-start day mid-week shifts the boundary of weekly limits. Rules with period=week will reset earlier or later than they would have. Continue?

settings_weekStartDesc.message: Used for weekly limits and the weekly sparkline on the rules page. Changing this mid-week shifts active weekly limits the first time.

settings_toolbarBadgeDesc.message: Show today's active time for the current domain on the extension icon.

settings_chartColorsDesc.message: Colors used for the charts on all pages. Pick a color or type a hex value. Default restores the theme color.
settings_chartColorsDesc.description: Shown under the chart colors title on the settings page. 'Default' refers to the colorPicker_default button label.

settings_resetColorsConfirm.message: Reset all chart colors to the theme defaults?

colorPicker_svLabel.message: Saturation and brightness. Adjust with arrow keys, hold Shift for larger steps.
colorPicker_svLabel.description: aria-label for the color picker's saturation/brightness area

colorPicker_hueLabel.message: Hue. Adjust with arrow keys, hold Shift for larger steps.
colorPicker_hueLabel.description: aria-label for the color picker's hue bar

drill_goUpLevel.message: Go up one level (day → week → month)

drill_goToFirst.message: Go to first day / week with data

site_deleteAllData.message: Delete all data for this site

site_hourly_allDays.message: (all days from earliest data, excluding today)

storage_indexedDbDesc.message: Stored in IndexedDB, outside the 10 MB cap. The bar shows the kind mix.

storage_quotaCapDesc.message: The 10 MB cap covers settings, favicon cache, rules and data imported from other apps, not the browsing data.

storage_quotaWarn.message: $1% of extension storage quota used. Clear the favicon cache or old data below to free space.

storage_backupDesc.message: Back up before running a large prune or delete.

storage_removeInsigDesc.message: Brief visits and accidental clicks accumulate. Scan and remove sites or pages whose total tracked time falls below a threshold.

storage_targetedDeletionDesc.message: Delete all data for a specific site, or remove records within an exact date and time window.

storage_dropSubpageDesc.message: Collapse old rows to site level by dropping their page path. Keeps site totals, sheds per-page detail to shrink the log.

storage_faviconCacheDesc.message: Cached site icons, stored in the 10 MB extension storage. Clearing frees space; icons reload from the browser as you visit sites.

storage_backupFormatDesc.message: Back up everything, or restore from a backup file: browsing data, rules and settings. New data merges in; wherever the file differs from your current data, you choose per category to keep yours or take the file's.

storage_ttCompatDesc1.message: Exchange data with the "Time Tracker - Web Habit Builder" extension (v

storage_ttCompatDesc2.message: ). Not all data is compatible. Imports land in a separate legacy store, kept apart from your tracked browsing: on any day that also has native tracking, the imported data stays hidden behind it.

storage_csvSpreadsheetDesc.message: Export your browsing data as a CSV file, openable in any spreadsheet app. Times are in decimal minutes.

storage_bulletOneRowPerSiteDay.message: One row per site/subpage, per day

storage_conflictDesc.message: These current rows overlap the file's rows in time. Keep current discards the overlapping rows from the file; Replace drops the rows listed below and takes the file's. Rows that don't overlap are always kept.

storage_corruptedFile.message: The file's tracking data is corrupted and could not be read.

storage_noDataToImport.message: The file has no data to import.

storage_dayConflictDesc.message: These days already have legacy data and also appear in the file. Keep current ignores those days from the file; Replace overwrites them. Days only in the file are always added.

storage_ruleConflictDesc.message: These sites already have a rule that differs from the file (scope, limit or mode). Keep current keeps your rules for these sites; Replace takes the file's. Rules for other sites are merged in either way.

storage_settingsConflictDesc.message: These settings differ between your current values and the file. Keep current keeps yours; Replace takes the file's. Settings you have not set yet are applied either way.

storage_noTtData.message: The file has no Time Tracker data to import.

storage_ttConflictDesc.message: These days already have data and also appear in the Time Tracker file. Keep current ignores those days from the file; Replace overwrites them. Days only in the file are always added.

storage_invalidJson.message: This file isn't valid JSON. It may be truncated or corrupted.

storage_unrecognizedFile.message: Unrecognized file. Expected a $1 export or a Time Tracker export.

storage_confirmDeleteAllRows.message: Delete all rows for $1? This permanently removes every interval row for $1 across all dates. This cannot be undone.

storage_confirmDeleteRepeat.message: Delete rows$1 for hours $2:00–$3:00 daily from $4 to $5? This cannot be undone.
storage_confirmDeleteRepeat.description: $1 = optional ' for <site>' scope, $2/$3 = hour range, $4/$5 = date range

storage_confirmDeleteContiguous.message: Delete all rows$1 from $2 $3:00 to $4 $5:00? This cannot be undone.

storage_confirmDeleteSelected.message: Delete all selected insignificant rows? This cannot be undone.

storage_enterValidDays.message: Enter a valid number of days

storage_confirmDropSubpage_one.message: Collapse rows older than $1 day to site level, dropping their page paths? Site totals stay; per-page detail is lost. This cannot be undone.

storage_confirmDropSubpage_other.message: Collapse rows older than $1 days to site level, dropping their page paths? Site totals stay; per-page detail is lost. This cannot be undone.

storage_confirmClearFavicons.message: Clear all favicons? Icons reload from the browser as you visit sites.

storage_legendRowsDetail.description: $1 = kind label, $2 = row count, $3 = optional size suffix

storage_confirmClearStale_one.message: Clear $1 icon for sites not visited in the last $2 day(s)? It reloads from the browser when next visited.

storage_confirmClearStale_other.message: Clear $1 icons for sites not visited in the last $2 day(s)? They reload from the browser when next visited.

legacy_quotaCapDesc.message: Chrome caps extension storage at 10 MB by default.

legacy_removeInsigDesc.message: Over time, brief visits and accidental clicks accumulate noise. Scan and remove entries whose total tracked time falls below a threshold.

legacy_hourlyDataDesc.message: Hourly stores track the same time as daily, at finer granularity. Old hourly data can be dropped once daily aggregates are accurate.

legacy_dataHealthDesc.message: Verifies hourly and daily aggregates are consistent. Targeted deletion reduces daily values from hourly data, small drifts accumulate over time.

legacy_confirmDeleteAllData.message: Delete all data for $1? This permanently removes all tracking records for $1 across all dates. This cannot be undone.

legacy_confirmDeleteRepeat.message: Delete records$1 for hours $2:00–$3:00 daily from $4 to $5? This cannot be undone.
legacy_confirmDeleteRepeat.description: $1 = optional ' for <site>' scope, $2/$3 = hour range, $4/$5 = date range

legacy_confirmDeleteContiguous.message: Delete all records$1 from $2 $3:00 to $4 $5:00? This cannot be undone.

legacy_calloutSites.description: $1 = formatted bytes with %, $2 = pluralized site count

legacy_calloutSubpages.description: $1 = formatted bytes with %, $2 = pluralized page count

legacy_confirmDropHourly_one.message: Drop $1 hourly data older than $2 day? Daily aggregates are preserved. This cannot be undone.

legacy_confirmDropHourly_other.message: Drop $1 hourly data older than $2 days? Daily aggregates are preserved. This cannot be undone.

legacy_hourlyDroppedFreed_one.message: Hourly data older than $1 day dropped, freed $2.

legacy_hourlyDroppedFreed_other.message: Hourly data older than $1 days dropped, freed $2.

legacy_issuesRepaired_one.message: $1 issue repaired. Tracking data is now consistent.

legacy_issuesRepaired_other.message: $1 issues repaired. Tracking data is now consistent.

legacy_noRecordsBelowThreshold.message: No records below the threshold in the selected stores.

legacy_selectedSummary.description: $1 = selected count, $2 = total, $3 = record count, $4 = optional approx-bytes suffix

legacy_confirmDeleteSelectedRecords.message: Delete all selected insignificant records? This cannot be undone.

legacy_atCurrentRate_one.message: At current rate: ~$1 day to cap

legacy_atCurrentRate_other.message: At current rate: ~$1 days to cap

quotes_empty.message: No saved quotes yet. Tap ♡ on the blocked page to save one.

settings_syncOff.message: Off. Your browsing data stays on this device.

settings_syncOn.message: On. Your data is shared with your other devices, end-to-end encrypted.

settings_syncSignedOut.message: This device was signed out. Enter your recovery phrase to sync again.

sync_offDesc.message: Your browsing data stays on this device. Turn sync on to see the same data on every device you use, and to apply limits to your total time across all of them.

sync_offPrivacy.message: No email, no phone number, no name. Your data is encrypted on this device before it is sent, and the server can never read it.

sync_signedOutDesc.message: Sync is paused here. Your browsing data on this device is untouched. Enter your recovery phrase to sync again.

sync_linkDesc.message: Type the 24-word recovery phrase from a device that is already syncing.

sync_linkNeeds24.message: A recovery phrase is exactly 24 words.

sync_linkWrongPhrase.message: No account matches that phrase. Check the words and try again.

sync_phraseDesc.message: These 24 words are the only way to add another device, and the only way back in if you lose this one. Anyone who has them can read your data. Keep them somewhere safe and offline.

sync_confirmDesc.message: Type three of the words to confirm you wrote them down correctly.

sync_confirmWrong.message: That does not match. Check your copy and try again.

sync_statusPaused.message: Syncing is paused until $1. Your data is safe on this device and will upload automatically.

sync_signOutConfirm.message: Sign out $1? It will stop syncing until someone enters the recovery phrase on it again.

sync_signOutSelfConfirm.message: Sign this device out? It will stop syncing until you enter your recovery phrase again. Your browsing data on this device stays.

sync_forgetConfirm.message: Remove this device from the list?

sync_forgetHasRows.message: This device still has data on the server. It is removed once that data is deleted.

sync_phraseAgainDesc.message: Show the 24 words again, for example to add another device.

sync_stopDesc.message: Stops sync on every device and permanently deletes everything stored on the server. The browsing data already on each device stays there.

sync_stopConfirm.message: Stop syncing on every device and delete everything stored on the server? The browsing data on each device stays. This cannot be undone.

sync_progressUploading.message: Uploading your history… $1 of $2 entries sent.

sync_signedOutStartDesc.message: Starting again creates a new account with a new recovery phrase and uploads this device's data to it. Use it when the old account is gone.
